description: Machine-contract fixture for signed Event scope_ref, projected object effective_scope, and Circle lifecycle basis evaluation. Producer supplies scope_circle_id where the payload owns it and signs the matching scope_ref; the reducer verifies that scope and may materialize effective_scope only in object read projections. Covers rebind transitions, DataEvent seal_ref and Control Move seal_basis evaluation, linear and concurrent archive, tombstone, restore barriers, and negative cases. See spec/v1/zh/models/circle.md §6.1 / §6.2 / §7 / §9.2 / §10.2.

submit_payload_shape.description: Generic actor-supplied scope fragment for object payload schemas that own scope_circle_id (for example Strand, Morph, Relation, and scoped Space creation/update). It MUST NOT carry effective_scope. Message and structural-operation payloads that derive scope from accepted target references do not embed this fragment; they still sign Event.scope_ref.

canonical_reducer_output_shape.description: Reducer-stamped, immutable tagged scope written to Event envelope and materialized object cell. Two discriminated forms: kind=realm | kind=circle.

scope_rebind_transition_cases.name: none_to_none_noop
scope_rebind_transition_cases.description: scope_circle_id=null -> scope_circle_id=null. No-op rebind; reducer MUST accept when the signed scope_ref remains {kind:realm}; the object projection effective_scope remains Realm-scoped.

scope_rebind_transition_cases.name: same_circle_to_same_circle_noop
scope_rebind_transition_cases.description: scope_circle_id=Some(A) -> scope_circle_id=Some(A). No-op rebind; reducer MUST accept.

scope_rebind_transition_cases.name: none_to_circle_default_reject
scope_rebind_transition_cases.description: scope_circle_id=null -> scope_circle_id=Some(A). True rebind; default reducer MUST reject with failed_precondition reason=scope_rebind_forbidden. Profile MAY enable audit-paired high-risk update.

scope_rebind_transition_cases.name: circle_to_none_default_reject
scope_rebind_transition_cases.description: scope_circle_id=Some(A) -> scope_circle_id=null. True rebind; default reducer MUST reject with failed_precondition reason=scope_rebind_forbidden. Profile MAY enable audit-paired high-risk update.

scope_rebind_transition_cases.name: circle_a_to_circle_b_default_reject
scope_rebind_transition_cases.description: scope_circle_id=Some(A) -> scope_circle_id=Some(B). True rebind across circles; default reducer MUST reject with failed_precondition reason=scope_rebind_forbidden. Profile MAY enable audit-paired high-risk update.

negative_cases.name: submit_payload_carrying_effective_scope_rejected
negative_cases.description: Actor MUST NOT supply effective_scope in submit payload. Reducer MUST schema_violation with reason=effective_scope_reducer_managed.

negative_cases.name: scope_circle_id_targets_inactive_circle
negative_cases.description: scope_circle_id references a Circle with state != active. Reducer MUST failed_precondition reason=circle_not_active.

negative_cases.name: scope_circle_id_realm_mismatch
negative_cases.description: scope_circle_id references a Circle whose realm_id != object.realm_id. Reducer MUST schema_violation reason=circle_realm_mismatch.

negative_cases.name: event_missing_scope_ref_rejected_at_schema
negative_cases.description: Every Event, including an ak.message.create derived from a Circle-scoped Strand, MUST carry signed scope_ref before reducer admission. Schema validation rejects a missing scope_ref; no receiver may accept first and later add or infer a wire field.

negative_cases.name: scope_ref_mismatches_scope_circle_id
negative_cases.description: The signed Event scope_ref MUST equal the scope derived from the target object's accepted projection: scope_circle_id=null -> {kind:realm}; scope_circle_id=C -> {kind:circle, circle_id:C}. Receiver MUST reject a mismatch and MUST NOT rewrite the signed field. A separately materialized object effective_scope is projection output and must copy the verified scope_ref.

negative_cases.name: signed_scope_ref_tamper
negative_cases.description: scope_ref is part of signed Event canonical bytes, so event_digest binds it directly. If a Seal later reports the DataEvent inside data_event_set_root, that root is an observational availability/projection proof, not control-plane finality. Mutating scope_ref after signing changes event_digest; receivers MUST reject with digest_mismatch. No separate scope field is added to seal.schema.json because the Event digest already carries this binding.

negative_cases.name: content_plaintext_under_e2ee_required
negative_cases.description: Realm.content_encryption_floor=e2ee_required requires the verified Event scope_ref for every Strand/Message/Morph/Blob content write to resolve to an MLS-backed scope (Realm-default MLS or Circle MLS). An ak.message.create carrying plaintext content, or whose verified scope_ref resolves to a Circle with encryption_profile=none, MUST be rejected with failed_precondition reason=content_encryption_floor_violation.
